slide.header: Executive Briefing: The Three-Ring Regional Sourcing Architecture
slide.subheader: A mathematically verified framework balancing cost arbitrage, skill depth, and candidate mobility
slide.components: - Card 1 (Ring 1 - Local & Intra-State Foundation): * Coimbatore self-sustains Quality Engineering (CL-3, 84 reqs, TSI 3.6/10) and core .NET/Java (CL-1, 113 reqs). * Escalate to Salem and Trichy after 15 days for 16%–23% cost arbitrage and high candidate retention (>75% OTJ). - Card 2 (Ring 2 - Regional Kerala Corridor): * Route Microsoft Fabric (CL-2, 76 reqs) and ServiceNow (CL-4, 44 reqs) to Kochi Infopark and Trivandrum Technopark. * Leverage near-parity compensation (-4.2% to -7.5% net variance) and the 2h 57m Vande Bharat rail corridor. - Card 3 (Ring 3 - Selective Metro Escalation): * Reserve Chennai and Bengaluru strictly for senior BFSI Consultative Architects (CL-5, 59 reqs, TSI 9.6/10). * Target native South Indian returnees seeking cost-of-living arbitrage (60% lower housing costs) to control salary inflation.

slide.layout: 2x2 Comparison Grid: Myths Busted vs. Grounded Facts
slide.header: Due-Diligence Reality Check: Busting Regional Myths in Coimbatore
slide.subheader: Forensic verification eliminates corporate churnalism and grounds workforce strategy in empirical fact
slide.components: - Quadrant 1 (Headcount Myth Busted): * Myth: "Coimbatore has only ~13,200 tech professionals" [F]. * Verified Fact: 13,200 is solely the single-building workforce of ELCOT Vilankurichi SEZ / TIDEL Park [V]. Total CBE tech base is 65,000–75,000 across Saravanampatti CHIL SEZ (40,000) and standalone campuses [C]. - Quadrant 2 (Employer Scale Distortions Busted): * Myth: "Cognizant employs 15,000+ in CBE; HCLTech employs 16,000 in Madurai" [F]. * Verified Fact: Active Cognizant CBE staff is 3,500–4,500 [C]. HCLTech Madurai is 5,400–6,000 (adding 1,000 via ₹150 Cr expansion) [C]. - Quadrant 3 (Export & Institutional Growth): * Coimbatore IT-SEZ exports reached ₹11,986.8 Cr in FY24–25 (up 14.9% from ₹10,433 Cr); total IT exports exceed ₹15,106 Cr [V]. - Quadrant 4 (Seniority Telemetry Boundary): * Requirements dataset has no explicit YOE column [V]. Seniority is an operational proxy inferred from designation titles (52% Senior/Lead, 13% Architect) requiring ATS validation [A].

slide.header: Coimbatore Talent Scarcity Index (TSI): Quantifying Local Friction
slide.subheader: An econometric regression model benchmarking local market depth, time-to-fill, and pedigree compliance
slide.components: - Mathematical Formulation: * Normalized TSI Formula: TSI = 10 * [0.35*(min(TTF, 120)/45) + 0.30*(1/(1+lambda)) + 0.20*Clock + 0.15*(1-Pcomp)] * Phi * Calibrated Normalization Scalar: Phi = 0.72 bounds scores strictly to [1.0, 10.0], fixing prior overflow flaws [C]. - Cluster Scarcity Scorecard (Ranked by Hiring Friction): * CL-5 Consulting Architecture: TSI 9.6 / 10 (Critical Deficit | TTF 118 days | Depth 0.15:1) * CL-2 Data Engineering & AI: TSI 8.4 / 10 (Severe Deficit | TTF 94 days | Depth 0.42:1) * CL-4 Enterprise SaaS/ServiceNow: TSI 7.9 / 10 (Structural Deficit | TTF 86 days | Depth 0.65:1) * CL-1 Enterprise Full-Stack: TSI 5.8 / 10 (Moderate Friction | TTF 68 days | Depth 1.80:1) * CL-3 Quality Engineering: TSI 3.6 / 10 (Self-Sustaining | TTF 48 days | Depth 3.40:1)

slide.layout: Split View: Transit Logistics (Left) + Talent Bandwidth (Right)

slide.components: - Left (Transit Telemetry & Commute Corridor): * Ernakulam-to-Coimbatore Vande Bharat Express (Train 26652) completes the trip in 2h 57m (14:20 -> 17:17, 6 days/week) [V]. * NH 544 via Palakkad connects Palakkad (50 km / 1 hr) and Thrissur (114 km / 2.5 hrs). * High feasibility for weekly executive commute (Monday morning arrival, Friday evening departure). - Right (Talent Bandwidth & The Hybrid Conversion Lever): * Massive tech base: Infopark Kochi (582 firms, 72k employees, ₹11,417 Cr exports) + Technopark TVM (540 firms, 84k employees, ₹17,092 Cr exports) [V]. * Anchor Sourcing Targets: IBS Software (logistics microservices), UST Global (cloud), Allianz Technology (BFSI backbones), Nissan Digital Hub (enterprise data). * Critical Hybrid Lever: Offering 3 days on-site / 2 days remote achieves 68% OTJ; a rigid 5-day on-site mandate collapses OTJ to 34% with 38% candidate drop-off [A].

Feeder for capital markets trading engines and transactional systems.

slide.header: Lateral Sourcing Directory: Target Companies & Notice Period Policies
slide.subheader: Tactical headhunting targets mapped by stack alignment, notice periods, and buyout openness
slide.components: - Cluster 1 (Full-Stack & Cloud): * Targets: IBS Software & Tata Elxsi (Kochi), Virtusa & Aspire Systems (Chennai), HCLTech & Chella (Madurai). * Policy: 60–90 day notice; buyout openness high at Aspire/IBS; rigid at Cognizant. - Cluster 2 (Data Engineering & Applied AI): * Targets: Allianz Technology & Nissan Digital Hub (Trivandrum), Tiger Analytics & Fractal (Bengaluru), KeyValue & Baker Hughes (Kochi). * Policy: 30–60 day notice at pure-play analytics firms; highly flexible buyouts. - Cluster 4 (Enterprise SaaS & ServiceNow ITOM): * Targets: WNS-Vuram (Trichy), Sify Technologies & Cognizant (Chennai), UST Global & Suyati (Kochi). * Policy: Target WNS-Vuram alumni for lower overhead and high CBE relocation affinity. - Cluster 5 (Consulting & BFSI Architecture): * Targets: Allianz & IBS (Kochi), SunTec & UST (Trivandrum), Standard Chartered GBS & Intellect Design (Chennai). * Policy: Standard 90-day notice; source candidates currently serving notice (<30 days).

slide.header: Recruiter Operational Playbook: Sourcing Decision Tree & Execution
slide.subheader: Standard operating procedures guiding recruiters from intake to offer release
slide.components: - Left (Sourcing Escalation Flowchart): * Day 01–15: Source locally in CBE (TIDEL/CHIL SEZ) for CL-3 (QE) and CL-1 (Full-Stack). * Day 15+: Escalate ServiceNow (CL-4) to Trichy (WNS-Vuram) and QA automation to Salem (Vee). * Day 30+: Escalate Microsoft Fabric (CL-2) and Insurance Architecture (CL-5) to Kochi and Trivandrum. * Day 45+: Escalate BFSI Solution Architects to Chennai and Bengaluru (native returnees only). - Right (Precision Boolean Search Strings): * Agentic AI Engineer: ("agentic AI" OR "LangGraph" OR "Semantic Kernel") AND ("Claude Code" OR "Codex" OR "RAG") * Microsoft Fabric Architect: ("Microsoft Fabric" OR "OneLake" OR "Direct Lake") AND ("PySpark" OR "Delta Lake") * ServiceNow ITOM Lead: ("ServiceNow") AND ("ITOM" OR "Discovery" OR "CMDB") AND ("IntegrationHub") * BFSI Solution Architect: ("Solution Architect") AND ("BFSI" OR "Banking") AND ("Presales" OR "RFP") AND ("Tier 1" OR "Cognizant" OR "Infosys" OR "Accenture")

slide.header: Financial Due-Diligence: Fully Loaded Unit Economics & Cost-to-Hire
slide.subheader: Re-deriving true Year-1 hiring outlays across local, intra-state, and metro relocation options
slide.components: - Mid-Senior Software Engineer (4–7 YOE) Fully Loaded Year-1 Cost: * Scenario A (Local CBE Lateral Hire): Base ₹14.16L + Reloc ₹0 + Buyout ₹0 + Sourcing Fee ₹1.18L + Ghosting Risk ₹0.10L = Total ₹15.44 Lakhs. * Scenario B (Tier-2 Intra-State - Salem/Trichy): Base ₹11.52L + Reloc ₹0.80L + Buyout ₹0 + Sourcing Fee ₹0.96L + Ghosting Risk ₹0.12L = Total ₹13.40 Lakhs (13.2% net operational savings vs local CBE!). * Scenario C (Metro Relocation - Bengaluru): Base ₹25.00L + Reloc ₹2.50L + Buyout ₹1.00L + Sourcing Fee ₹2.08L + Ghosting Risk ₹1.45L = Total ₹32.03 Lakhs (+107% cost premium over Tier-2 TN!). - Financial Governance Guardrails: * Base Salary Hike Caps: CBE Local: 15–20% | Tier-2 TN: 25–30% | Kerala: 20–25% | Metro Returnees: 0–10%. * Notice Buyouts: Capped strictly at 30 days basic pay; restricted to Leads/Architects in CL-2/CL-4/CL-5. * Legal Protection: Mandatory 18-month clawback on all relocation, buyout, and sign-on incentives.

slide.header: Phased 60-Day Execution Roadmap & Red-Team Risk Controls
slide.subheader: A structured operational ramp engineered to mitigate 90-day notice lock-in and candidate reneging
slide.components: - Phased Operational Milestones: * Days 01–15: Local fulfillment for CL-3 (QE) & base CL-1 (.NET/Java) + Slot-1 campus engagement at PSG/CIT. * Days 16–30: Intra-state expansion (Trichy for ServiceNow, Salem for QA, Madurai for capital markets). * Days 31–45: Kerala corridor headhunting (Kochi/TVM for Fabric/AI squads and insurance architecture). * Days 46–60: Metro escalation for BFSI architects (native returnees only) + offer retention lock-in. - Adversarial Failure Mode Controls: * 90-Day Notice Trap: Target candidates already serving notice (<30 days); offer 10–15% early-joiner bonuses. * Counter-Offer Reneging: Weekly technical touchpoints with project delivery leads to keep ghosting <12%. * Commute Burnout: Provide family relocation counseling and corporate school admission tie-ups in CBE.

slide.subheader: Critical organizational sign-offs necessary to operationalize the 3-ring sourcing architecture
slide.components: - Decision 1 (Hybrid Workplace Approval): Formal sign-off on 3+2 hybrid schedule for Kerala commuters (critical to prevent 50% OTJ drop). - Decision 2 (Seniority Telemetry Policy): Delivery unit alignment on title-to-YOE technical screening scorecards. - Decision 3 (Notice Buyout Pool Allocation): CFO approval of a dedicated 30-day notice buyout pool for CL-2, CL-4, and CL-5. - Decision 4 (Internal L&D Reskilling Budget): Approval for a 6-week Fabric/Agentic boot camp to reskill internal .NET/Data squads. - Decision 5 (Client MSA Verification): Legal validation of hybrid delivery compliance for Fitch, Advantive, and Marvell accounts. - Decision 6 (Regional Compensation Parity): Enforcing geographic hike caps to protect corporate gross margins. - Decision 7 (Campus Placement Drive Dates): Locking early campus placement dates at PSG Tech, CIT, Sona, and MEC. - Decision 8 (Contractual Clawback Mandate): Legal sign-off on 18-month clawback clauses across all offer packages.
